label: Container
purpose: A layout box that groups nested content blocks with configurable direction, background, and border styling
_notes: Real Liquid schema also declares its own nested `blocks` list (button, heading, text, image, and 20+ other types it can contain) — nested block-in-block containment isn't represented by this catalog's schema format (allowed_blocks only exists on SECTIONS today), so this schema only covers the container's OWN settings, not what can be nested inside it. Real schema also has extensive padding/margin/media-background/gradient-border styling settings, omitted here as decorative.
